messages:
Rina: Quick heads-up- new model bring-up (q-int4) for nova13b showing a small but reproducible drop on the 'extract_action_items' intent when compared to float baseline. Failure modes look focused on nested steps and implicit deadlines. Dataset: ds-queue-9, sample seed 2026-04-01. Can curation carve out a targeted golden + holdout?

Evan: Yep. What's the exact sampling query and desired golden size? I can run a fast dedupe sweep.

Rina: We pulled a 600-sample diagnostic with this:
```bash
curate sample --dataset ds-queue-9 --filter "intent:extract_action_items" --size 600 --seed 20260401 --stratify "severity,lang" --min_len 80 --export nova13b_diag.csv
```
Goal: 250 golden candidates, of which 50 become a locked holdout for q-int4 eval. Prefer to avoid duplicates with current golden anchors.

labelops-bot: Queue created: `gold-nova13b-170500` (250 items). Owner: Nadia. Holdout set reserved: 50.

Theo: For dedupe I recommend simhash + token-span combo. I set simhash threshold to 0.84 and a Jaccard span overlap > 0.6 to flag near-duplicates. Small snippet:```python
# simhash dedupe
from simhashlib import simhash
flags = [s for s in samples if simhash(s['text']).distance_to_db(golden_hashes) < 0.84]
```
We should also check for paraphrase clusters (fast embeddings).

Nadia: I'll take the relabel work. Timeline: tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Any schema changes? We currently store fields: prompt, actions[], confidence_hint, deid, provenance. Should we add `implicit_deadline` boolean?

Rina: Yes, add implicit_deadline and multi_step boolean. Also add a freeform 'failure_notes' field for annotators to mark what model missed. This helps triage regressions.

bench-bot: Regression check stub created: `bench/nova13b/qint4-vs-float/extract_action_items`. Baseline metric: action_precision@1. Current delta: -0.058.

Evan: I'll run an embed-recall pass using e5-large (lower recall threshold 0.65) to map neighbors into the golden corpus and the locked holdout. Will post neighbor CSV with match scores.

Theo: Suggest we keep synthetic augmentation minimal: generate up to 75 paraphrases for tricky nested-step cases with a low-confidence flag so they never enter the locked holdout. Use paraphrase-worker v2, tag as `synth:paraphrase-v2`.

Nadia: Confirmed. I'll only accept synth into the candidate pool if paired with an original and flagged for review. Real golden must be human-labeled.

Rina: Plan summary: 1) Evan run simhash+span dedupe (thr 0.84) -> prune 600 -> ~250 candidates; 2) Evan embed-recall (e5-large, thr 0.65) -> neighbor map; 3) Nadia relabels 250 queue, locking 50 as holdout; 4) Theo prepares up-to-75 synth paraphrases (review-only). Bench run will compare q-int4 to float on the new holdout. Ping this thread when neighbor map + dedupe finished. :rocket:

Evan: On it. Posting dedupe results and neighbor map in ~3h.

Nadia: Thanks 44d Ill start review when you post.

Rina: Thanks team — let's try to keep the holdout frozen once locked so bench comparisons are stable.

bench-bot: Reminder: please add `provenance.sha256` for each golden item so we can detect silent drift in future resamples.
